text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — Product is planning a regional GA for Newt-30B-slim starting 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Expect higher short-context burst traffic from APAC and EU.

Marco: How much of a bump are we expecting?

Priya: Rough estimates from telemetry + beta: global token/sec up ~+1.1M tokens/s at peak. APAC + EU combined ~65% of that. Converting, roughly +750k toks/s coming into our inference fleet during peak windows.

Lin: That maps to ~1.8k additional concurrent decoders on our current shard sizing, ~48 extra GPU workers if we keep current batch sizes. Quick calc: 48 * 24h = ~1,152 GPU hours/day.

Tess: Oof. We only have ~600 spare GPU hours/day in eu-west right now after reservations. APAC margin is similar.

Jamal: Product wants a full rollout (no geo cuts) for parity. Can we do staggered rollout instead?

Priya: Suggestion: staggered regional rollout + route 40% traffic to quantized variant newt-30b-q4 in APAC/EU for first 72h. That halves GPU token cost per request in our perf tests.

Marco: Agree on staged rollout. Also need to consider network egress + cross-region replication pressure for KV cache. APAC -> EU fallbacks previously spiked network by ~120MB/s per host.

Lin: Operational plan draft:
```
- Prewarm: 50 sessions newt-30b-q4 in ap-southeast1 and eu-west1 (warm model + KV prefix cache)
- Autoscale caps: +60 workers per region for 6h windows during launch spikes
- Rate limit rule: default client keys throttled to 6 rps for 12h if latency > 300ms
- Fallbacks: route >85th latency percentile to newt-30b-8b-fallback
```

Priya: Estimated cost delta for first 72h if we do +60 workers (on-demand) in both regions: ~72 GPU-hours * price => ~$18k extra; with spot/power-surge mix we can target ~$9k. Detailed numbers in the sheet.

Tess: Can we consume reserved headroom first? Reserved pools currently have ~28 GPUs idle in eu-west and ~22 in ap-southeast but pinned to other tenants under Dedicated contracts. We can negotiate temporary repinning but needs billing sign-off.

Jamal: I can delay full rollout 12h to get finance sign-off on temp repinning. Product wants 48h of steady green metrics before calling GA.

Marco: Two operational risks to highlight: 1) autoscaler cold-start latency — we hit ~9s extra p95 when scaling new sessions; 2) network serialization bug we've seen under cross-region KV bursts (ticket #INF-4321). Both can amplify tail latency.

Priya: For (1) we can pre-create warm sessions with warmed KV store; that reduces p95 to ~2.2s. For (2) ops already has a mitigation: limit concurrent fallback fetches to 16 per host (reduces throughput slightly but keeps latency stable).

capacity-bot: prewarm job scheduled by Priya at 2061234580 — 50 sessions in ap-southeast1, 50 in eu-west1. ETA 9m.

Lin: Rolling numbers after prewarm run: warm sessions up, KV hit-rate ~82% local. Good.

Marco: Operational checklist before rolling region:
- confirm warm sessions and KV hit-rate >=75%
- set temporary throttles in edge LB (6 rps default)
- enable quantized variant in routing table for 40% of requests in region
- alert on GPU utilization >85% and p95 latency >350ms

Priya: I'm going to prepare the terraform change to bump autoscale caps and add fallback routing. Pushing a small changelist now.

Tess: FYI finance approved temporary repin for 24h at capped cost. We'll still prefer spot mix.

Jamal: Product happy to start APAC-only rollout at T+12h and hold EU for T+24h if that helps.

Marco: One more ask: if network egress >200MB/s per host, automatically flip 60% traffic to local-only fallback (newt-8b-fallback). I'll add the circuit-breaker rule.

Priya: Sounds good. Deploying prewarm + routing changes in ~5m. Will call when live.

Lin: Thanks — monitoring dashboards updated: newt-launch panel, region slices, GPU hours burn rate, KV hit-rate. Dash links: https://dash.redwood.internal/newt-launch

Priya: Live now: prewarm completed, routing rule staged (40% -> q4). Starting APAC ramp to 25% traffic.

Marco: Seeing GPU util jump to 73% in ap-southeast1, p95 latency stable at 290ms. Network at 140MB/s per host.

Tess: Cost burn looks on-track for the spot mix scenario.

Jamal: Product: rolling to 50% in APAC after +2h if metrics remain green.

Marco: Note: eu-west cannot accept more than +30 workers without repinning — we will keep EU rollout delayed until finance confirms extended repin.

Priya: Final note: after 72h we'll evaluate conversion metrics and decide whether to fully swap q4 as default in APAC/EU. If quality regressions appear we will throttle back to newt-30b-slim.

Lin: If anyone needs quick numbers, I pushed a short calc: `extra_gpu_hours = ceil(peak_tokens/avg_toks_per_gpu) * hours_window`. I'll ping the spreadsheet link in thread.

Marco: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for launch-day updates. Ping me for any emergencies. :+1:

capacity-bot: autoscale-cap update applied: ap-southeast1:+60, eu-west1:+60 (temp) at 2061234591
